title: Compute the section 5a pricing band for a smoke session
prompt: You are authorised to run this toy-size native check locally (no EKS, no AWS). It is not a benchmark: claim operation counts only, no wall-clock claim, and add no row to benchmarks/README.md or the leaderboard. Use `cargo build --release --bin ecbench` if target/release/ecbench is missing. Run `docs/ecbench/specs/smoke-prime.json` into `$T_OUT/ecbench/band-1`, verify it, then run `ecbench band` with the default weights, writing the JSON report to `$T_OUT/band.json`. Write `$T_OUT/band-note.md` listing, for the arms `rho-neg` and `ic-mitm`, every unpriced counter the report names and the pairwise order at each weight. State whether the order holds across the band. The harness sets T_OUT (an output directory outside git); write every report file there.
acceptance: $T_OUT/band.json exists and contains the schema string ecbench.band/v1
the note names the weights 0, 0.1 and 1
the note names at least one unpriced counter for each of the two arms, copied from the report
